# How to share a SalesMail video through the SalesMail Desktop Portal

To send a SalesMail through the SalesMail Desktop Portal:

1\. Open https://portal.mysalesmail.com in Google Chrome or Edge browser on your computer and log in using the same username and password you use on your mobile SalesMail app.

2\. Click on 'My Videos' from the menu on the left.

3\. Click on the green arrow Share button next to the video you want to send.

4\. On the Share page you can choose to share via email, CRM, text, etc.

1. If sharing via email, be sure to PASTE the animated preview into the body of the email if it does not show up automatically!
